sanskrit_verse:
न हीनपक्षां युवतिं कुले जातां प्रसूतिकाम् ।
सर्ववर्णोत्तमां कन्यां ताः ज्ञातिप्रभुक्ताः स्मृताः ॥
transliteration: na hīnapakṣāṃ yuvatiṃ kule jātāṃ prasūtikām / sarvavarṇottamāṃ kanyāṃ tāḥ jñātiprabhuktāḥ smṛtāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who cohabit with a woman born in their lineage, capable of procreation, or with the supreme maiden of all varṇas, are deemed as having enjoyed kinship rights.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from relational dharma and not mere biological connection
Causation arises through conscious choice within familial and societal dharmic structures
Capacity-based responsibility includes recognition of reproductive potential and social standing
Restoration logic demands realignment of relational integrity and ancestral continuity
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of unity beneath varṇic diversity
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual engages sexually with a female member of the same kulaja (lineage-born) AND she is of reproductive age THEN legal status shall recognize relational duty obligations
IF engagement occurs with a kanyā identified as 'sarvavarṇottamā' THEN such act invokes inter-varṇa relational protocols under dharma-adhikāra
NO punitive consequence MAY be enforced BUT relational correction protocols MUST activate immediately upon violation detection
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving intra-lineage or cross-varṇa sexual conduct, the Supreme Court must assess not guilt or innocence, but the disruption caused to dharma-vyavasthā (cosmic-social order). The threshold of responsibility lies in the conscious choice to engage without honoring relational boundaries. Authority flows from restoration of those boundaries, not imposition of penalty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that action originates from willful choice within recognized relational contexts. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how imbalance manifests when dharma-sambandha (duty-based relationship) is violated. Proportional responsibility aligns with the extent of relational distortion. Non-punitive reality holds because suffering cannot restore consciousness; only reintegration can.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process where parties reaffirm relational duties through ritual acknowledgment
Assign capacity restoration practices including vrata observance and guru-guided śuddhi upāsanā
Reintegrate both individuals into community structure via declared alignment with cosmic harmony
Establish ongoing mentorship until full consciousness alignment with dharmic sambandha is restored
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Dharma stands restored through consciousness realignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
